concerns: The comment type is represented as a plain String (COMMENT or UPDATE_REQUEST) rather than a strongly typed Enum.
User role modification occurs as a side-effect in the user resolution logic when the X-User-Role header differs from the stored user role.
All comments for a document are retrieved on every document read request, which could cause performance issues as the comment history grows; pagination should be considered.
The resolveUser helper has a side effect of updating a user's role in the database when the header value changes.

Favorite creation has a non-atomic check-then-act sequence (existsById followed by save), which could result in duplicate key exceptions under high concurrent write load instead of a clean handled scenario.
The DOCX generation constructs raw XML via string manipulation rather than using a compliant XML builder, which might limit future complexity or readability.

Retrieval of the latest version of the document uses doc.getVersions().stream() directly, which could trigger a lazy loading exception or inefficient database fetches depending on the JPA mapping configuration.
The resolveUser helper has a side effect of updating a user's role in the database when the header value changes.
